snippet.title: FPP Unlocked This Summer – Dive and Immerse
snippet.description:
Fast. Loud. Personal.
First-person mode is evolved and it's more than a feature.
It’s your new battlefield instinct.
It's a Farlight you've never seen before.
This summer, a new war awaits.


ABOUT FARLIGHT 84

In Farlight 84, you get to play as heroes with unique skills to outsmart your enemies, unleashing special abilities to catch them off guard... AND you get to collect adorable Buddies to join you as loyal companions in battle. Buddy up, it’s time to Battle Royale!
